name: Abjuration
description: The magic of keeping things out: rain, drafts, moths, and the neighbor's goose. Wards, mostly, and very good ones.

name: Conjuration
description: Fetching and carrying, without the walking. Mostly it moves furniture, and now and then it brings back something you did not ask for.

name: Divination
description: The magic of finding out. Lost keys, tomorrow's weather, and who finished the biscuits.

name: Enchantment
description: The gentle art of persuasion. It cheers up customers, settles geese, and has never once worked on a cat.

name: Evocation
description: Raw energy, pointed somewhere useful. It lights stoves, forges, and lanterns, and can do rather more if asked.

name: Illusion
description: Decorating with things that are not quite there. Lovely for shop windows and surprise parties.

name: Necromancy
description: Looking after what comes after. It tends graves, keeps the pantry from spoiling, and chats with polite ghosts.

name: Transmutation
description: Changing one thing into a slightly better thing. Mending, reshaping, and turning leftovers into supper.
